thread:
Javier: GreenLeaf (insurer) wants a POC that keeps all data and logs in EU or UK. Theyre picky: control plane must not touch non-EU/UK subprocessors, audit logs must stay in-customer-specified S3 in eu-west-1, and BYO-KMS preferred. They asked for a 14-day pilot and a prod estimate. Can we scope? cc @Lena @Tom

Lena: Quick split: 1) Data plane (payload) pinning to eu-west-1 + eu-west-2 is straightforward. 2) Control plane locality is the hard part  Hosted control plane = us-central. We can do a scoped mitigation for presales (disable telemetry, tenant pin, BYO-KMS) but legal won't accept that as a contractual EU-control-plane.

Tom (ops): Ops note: For the POC we can do: tenant pin to eu-west-1, wire BYO-KMS (customer key in eu-west-1), and configure server-side delivery of audit logs to customer S3. We must disable stack-level tracing and any third-party analytics. That prevents telemetry flowing to our US logging.

Asha (acct): They explicitly said "no US subprocessors for control-plane or telemetry" in the SOW. They accept a time-limited attestation for presales if its technically true. They asked whether Cloudflare or our edge CDN would disqualify them.

Meera (legal): Attestation guidance: we can sign a limited technical attestation covering the scoped 14-day pilot that enumerates what's disabled and where logs will be stored. Important to flag: attestation != contractual promise. For contractual commitments we need Dedicated/Private with verified EU/UK co-located control plane and subprocessors.

Tom: Practical checklist for POC (ops runbook snippet):
```yaml
tenant: greenleaf-poc
region_pin: eu-west-1
byo_kms: true
audit_log_sink: s3://greenleaf-poc-audit (eu-west-1)
telemetry: disabled
edge_cdn: disabled_for_tenant
failure_mode: reject
```

Javier: Who would still see metadata in this POC if we follow the checklist? They singled out "any metadata hitting non-EU/UK vendors" as a deal-stopper.

Tom: With the checklist applied: payload  AWS eu-west-1 only; audit logs  customer S3 in eu-west-1; telemetry/traces  disabled. Subprocessors removed: Datadog, Sentry, our central GCP logging. Cloudflare is disabled for the tenant. There is one caveat: control-plane orchestration signals still normally go through our control plane (us-central) for hosted. For the POC we'll route management APIs via a temporary EU proxy we spin up to avoid US hops. That proxy will not persist customer data and will be part of the POC mitigation.

Lena: Cost/time for pilot: one-time setup ~ $1.2k (peering/proxy + ops), monthly ops overhead prorated for 14 days ~ $600, engineering time ~ 8h (config + attestation) billed as professional service if required. Prod Dedicated EU/UK control plane estimate: starting ~ $13k/month (includes control plane nodes and reserved capacity).

Asha: Customer wants the 14-day pilot price today. I'll give them a $2.2k all-in pilot quote (setup + two-week ops + small PS margin) and note that Dedicated pricing is separate. Can Ops/Legal confirm wording for the attestation?

Meera: Draft attestation language (short): "For the scoped 14-day proof-of-concept, Redwood will: 1) Pin the customer's compute to EU (eu-west-1), 2) Configure customer-managed KMS in eu-west-1, 3) Disable telemetry and third-party analytics for the tenant, 4) Deliver all audit logs directly to the customer's specified S3 bucket in eu-west-1, and 5) Route management/control-plane signaling for the POC via a temporary EU-resident proxy to avoid non-EU subprocessors. This attestation is time-limited and technical in scope; contractual EU-only guarantees require Dedicated or Private deployment and a signed amendment."

Tom: I'll spin up the proxy and open a ticket. Need customer's AWS bucket ARN and KMS key ARN to test. ETA 2 business days to get POC ready once we have those.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-8219 created: "GreenLeaf POC - EU/UK audit logs & BYO-KMS" assigned to Tom.

Javier: I'll request bucket/key today and share POC acceptance criteria. Thanks all 44d

Lena: One more operational note: if they later ask for UK-control-plane specifically (London region), add ~2-3 weeks provisioning and a slight price bump. We'll call that out in the proposal.

Asha: I'll send the pilot quote + attestation to GreenLeaf and loop legal on acceptance. Keeping updates here.
